# Let's Roll — BJJ Instructor Booking Portal

> Let's Roll is a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu private-session booking platform. Clients can discover certified BJJ instructors, view their services and pricing, and book one-on-one training sessions directly online — no account required.

## Key public pages

- Instructor directory (all available coaches): https://bjj-session-planner.replit.app/book/
- Individual instructor profiles and booking: https://bjj-session-planner.replit.app/book/{instructor-slug}
- Book a session with an instructor: https://bjj-session-planner.replit.app/book/{instructor-slug}/book
- Full sitemap of all instructor pages: https://bjj-session-planner.replit.app/api/public/sitemap.xml

## Notes

- All instructor profile URLs follow the pattern /book/{slug} where {slug} is a unique identifier for each instructor.
- Booking confirmation and session management pages require a private token and are not intended for indexing.
- Auth pages (/book/login, /book/signup, etc.) are for client account management and are not useful for AI summarization.
